title: Gothic Cathedral Showdown
description: A blue-haired woman in revealing grey armor kneels on a cobblestone path, gripping a large ornate hammer with both hands. Behind her stands a horned purple demon in a form-fitting suit at the entrance of a massive gothic cathedral under a dramatic fiery sky with a green celestial orb.
prompt: A blue-haired female warrior with short hair kneels on broken cobblestones in front of a towering gothic cathedral with a large rose window, holding a massive red and gold hammer. A purple horned demon in a tight bodysuit stands in the dark archway behind her. Dramatic fiery red and orange sky with swirling clouds and a glowing green orb, cinematic fantasy lighting, highly detailed digital painting.
